name: websocketConnect
description: Connects to a remote or local WebSocket server (ws:// or wss://).
parameters:
url: String — Target WebSocket URL.
connectionId: String (optional) — ID of the connection, defaults to 'default'.
returns: Boolean — True if connection process started.

name: websocketSend
description: Sends a text message or JSON payload over an active WebSocket connection.
parameters:
message: String — Text message payload to send.
connectionId: String (optional) — ID of the connection, defaults to 'default'.
returns: Boolean — True if message was sent.

name: websocketDisconnect
description: Closes an active WebSocket connection gracefully.
parameters: connectionId: String (optional) — ID of the connection to close, defaults to 'default'.

name: websocketStatus
description: Returns the current state of a WebSocket connection ('CONNECTED', 'CONNECTING', 'DISCONNECTED', 'CLOSED', 'ERROR').
parameters: connectionId: String (optional) — ID of the connection, defaults to 'default'.
